name: Admin Customers — list, search, credit filter, profile

planSteps.description: Enter phone number 923001234567 and click Send Code
Navigate to the Customers page via More menu or tab

The Customers page loads showing total outstanding amount, on credit count, search bar, filter tabs (All Customers, On Credit), and customer list with name, phone, credit usage percentage, credit health status, and outstanding balance
Only customers with outstanding credit balances are shown
Type a customer name in the search bar
The customer list filters to show only matching customers

The customer profile page opens showing customer photo, name, phone, address, credit health badge, purchases total, paid total, outstanding amount, and action buttons (Purchase History, Payment History, Record Payment, Edit Customer, Delete Customer)
